gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-old-turkic: Wide, loud, a little swaggering: Goldman spreads its letters out with room to spare. Noto Sans Old Turkic then settles into a plain sans rhythm, its chunky, tall lowercase and open-mouthed curves staying easy to follow line after line.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-runic: Broad and brash, Goldman takes the stage with round forms like open parentheses. Noto Sans Runic follows with a big x-height and curves that never close back on themselves, so paragraphs of sans-serif text keep moving without snagging.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-soyombo: Noto Sans Soyombo reads as a plain sans with a sizable x-height and curved letters whose mouths stay wide open. And Goldman, spaced generously and commanding, gives it a heading with real presence to sit under.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-syriac-weste: Goldman looks wide, bold and unhurried. Noto Sans Syriac Western packs its small letters tall like bundled cable, yet terminals held far from the stroke keep a long paragraph of plain sans text from clogging.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-tai-tham: Goldman is bold, wide and sure of itself. Noto Sans Tai Tham crowds its chalk-board lowercase up toward the capital line, yet the inside of each c stays visible, so a long plain sans paragraph still reads clearly.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-tc: Commanding, wide and confident, Goldman leads. Noto Sans TC brings large open counters in tall a, e and s, with curves that open outward, and that generous openness is the strongest thing about this pair.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Goldman stretches out wide and bold, round like open parentheses. And Noto Sans Telugu, a plain sans with a high-set midline and counters that stay connected to the outside, makes the strongest quality here a crisp, professional steadiness.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Goldman's wide, generously spaced letters give it a commanding stance. Noto Sans Tifinagh, a plain sans with rounded, inviting lowercase bowls that fill the line like inflated shapes, handles the quieter, friendlier work of everyday reading.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-vai: Goldman's round forms read like open parentheses, wide and commanding. Noto Sans Vai makes words look like solid blocks rather than skylines, so enlarging it would lose the bold distance Goldman holds as a heading.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-warang-citi: Noto Sans Warang Citi makes words read as solid blocks, with wide channels leading into each counter. And Goldman, wide and bold with a big lowercase, gives those blocks a commanding sign to stand beneath.
